image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a male mallard duck (drake) resting on what appears to be a wooden surface or log. The duck features a glossy iridescent green head, a distinct white neck ring, a chestnut-brown breast, and a greyish body. Its bill is bright yellow with a black tip and nostrils. The background consists of blurred foliage and wood textures.

The visible eye is dark brown/black, consistent with the taxonomy.
